User Stories: As a user, I want to try on a clothing item.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall layer the transparent PNG over the avatar and update instantly (FR-5.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Try-On Canvas
2. Select category = Tops
3. Select an item
4. Verify it renders on the avatar

User Stories: As a user, I want to switch to a different item in the same category.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall replace the previous item with the new one (FR-5.2).
Steps to Test:
1. Equip a Top
2. Select a different Top
3. Verify the previous item is replaced

User Stories: As a user, I want to equip a Dress/One-Piece outfit.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall replace both Top and Bottom slots and confirm replacement (FR-5.2).
Steps to Test:
1. Equip a Top and a Bottom
2. Equip a Dress
3. Verify confirmation and both slots replaced

User Stories: As a user, I want to switch between Front and Rear views.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall instantly update avatar and all clothing to the selected angle without reload (FR-2.6, FR-5.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Equip items
2. Click Front/Rear toggle
3. Verify all items update to the new view

User Stories: As a user, I want the try-on experience to feel fluid.
Acceptance Criteria: Overlay changes (item switch, view switch, proportion adjust) shall render within 1 second (Criterion 2).
Steps to Test:
1. Switch an item
2. Toggle view
3. Adjust a proportion
4. Time each render

User Stories: As a user, I want to try on an item. The clothing image failed to load.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall show an error, retain the previous item, and allow selecting another (UC-03 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Simulate a failed clothing image load
2. Verify error and previous item retained
3. Select a different item

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to save my current outfit.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall save the named outfit combination (FR-5.4).
Steps to Test:
1. Equip items
2. Click Save Outfit
3. Enter outfit name
4. Save

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Registered User with a saved outfit
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to load a saved outfit.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall retrieve and auto-equip all items in the outfit (FR-5.6).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Outfit Management
2. Select an outfit
3. Load it
4. Verify all items equipped

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Saved outfit contains a deleted catalog item
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to load an outfit. One item no longer exists in the catalog.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall warn, load available items only, and skip the missing item (UC-10 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Delete a catalog item that is in a saved outfit
2. Load that outfit
3. Verify warning and available items loaded

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to edit and delete my saved outfits.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall update and permanently delete outfits (FR-5.7, FR-5.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Outfit Management
2. Edit an outfit and save
3. Delete an outfit and confirm

User Stories: As a first-time Guest, I want to complete a try-on quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: First-time Guest completes one try-on within ≤2 minutes without training (Criterion 6).
Steps to Test:
1. Start timer.
2. Guest creates avatar.
3. Equips item.
4. Toggles view.
5. Stop timer.
